fields.FIR_Description: A online complaint dated 2026-05-01 states that the complainant received messages threatening to circulate private material online unless Rs. 25,000 was paid, on 2026-05-01 at roughly 08:10. Kalaiselvi Raman submitted the complaint online using the mobile number 9000000010. Kishore Babu (9000000076), described as a relative of the suspect, was also mentioned in the complaint. The complaint mentions Arjun Shankar, who was reportedly contacted on 9000000136, in connection with the events. Potentially relevant material referenced includes digital documents.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Payment reportedly demanded under a threat of public exposure.
fields.Keywords: blackmail, online threat, digital document, main street, mobile number, associate, morning, suspect
